t.why: With an average elevation of just over 1 m, it is among the most vulnerable to the climate crisis, and it speaks out on the world stage.
t.rel: An island country southwest of India and one of the most vulnerable to rising seas. Depending on the government, it has shifted its weight back and forth between India and China.
t.know: It is famous for 'one island, one resort' tourism.
t.etext: Tourism, especially resorts that take up whole islands, is the heart of the economy, along with fishing. Government debt is high, and it is vulnerable to rising seas.
